title: Enforce the complete completion-report schema and honesty invariants
problem: Verified: the gate checks result enums and reason presence only; it does not require summary, non-empty command/check fields, typed lists, or a reason mapping for commands marked not_executed. Proposed impact: structurally incomplete completion evidence can pass.
acceptance: Reports missing summary, command/check, or not_executed reasons exit 1 with field-specific diagnostics.
A valid report remains passing with both PyYAML and python -S fallback paths.
--json output remains exactly one parseable JSON document on pass and failure paths.

title: Fail closed when an explicit non-goal constitution is malformed
problem: Verified: YAML parse/type errors in check-nongoal.py collapse to an empty goal list, which is then treated like a missing constitution and exits 0 with only a warning. Proposed impact: a malformed constitution silently disables hard non-goal boundaries.
acceptance: Malformed YAML and non-list explicit_non_goals values exit nonzero and report an invalid constitution status.
A genuinely missing constitution retains its documented warning behavior, while an explicit empty list is distinguished as valid.
Valid minimal constitutions still detect collisions, including under the python -S fallback path.

title: Make design-intelligence checks evaluate each UI component independently
problem: Verified: _check_empty_state returns clean when any empty-state occurrence has an action, and _check_dual_encoding returns clean when any StatusChip exists anywhere in the file. Proposed impact: a file containing both compliant and violating components can pass while bad UI remains.
acceptance: A file with one bare EmptyState and one actionable EmptyState reports empty_state_no_action and exits 1.
A file with bare status text plus a separate StatusChip reports status_not_dual_encoded.
All-compliant mixed-component fixtures pass and existing single-component regressions remain green.
